# pxc_helm_mirror (Resource)

Helm mirror via harbor oci if configured (auto discovered).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `chart` (String) Helm chart name within that repository.
- `source_name` (String) Name for the repository to add (passed to helm repo add NAME URL).
- `source_repository` (String) Repository of the helm chart to mirror.
- `version` (String) Version of the helm chart to mirror.

### Read-Only

- `repository_out` (String) Resulting repository url, either oci of the harbor registry or the original if no mirroring was discovered.
